# `firearms.client.scope` — root

Every type with its summary and every non-private constructor, method and constant. The
signature is the contract; read the source only when the summary is not enough.

The scope mechanic's client-only support: resolving a held weapon's optic and its zoom factor and overlay texture (`docs/spec/domains/combat.md` COMBAT-REQ-006–008), read by the three mixins in firearms.mixin.client that actually apply it.

### `class ScopeOverlay` — `src/main/java/firearms/client/scope/ScopeOverlay.java`
The overlay texture `firearms.mixin.client.ScopeOverlayMixin` draws in place of vanilla's own SPYGLASS_SCOPE_LOCATION (`COMBAT-REQ-008`).
- `Identifier texture(Attachment optic)` — The overlay texture to draw while scoped through optic.

### `class ScopeZoom` — `src/main/java/firearms/client/scope/ScopeZoom.java`
The pure "does this optic zoom" mapping (`docs/spec/domains/combat.md` COMBAT-REQ-006, COMBAT-DEC-004; `docs/spec/domains/attach.md` §3): an optic magnifies only when its own Attachment#zoom() is strictly greater than 1.0.
- `OptionalDouble of(Attachment optic)` — optic's own zoom factor, if it magnifies at all.

### `class ScopedWeapon` — `src/main/java/firearms/client/scope/ScopedWeapon.java`
Resolves the optic the three scope mixins care about straight off a held ItemStack — a firearms:weapon stack's own firearms:attachment_optic component — matched against Attachment#ALL's 22 hardcoded constants rather than firearms.data.AttachmentRegistry.
- `Optional<Attachment> optic(ItemStack stack)` — The attachment in stack's optic slot, if stack is a weapon, the slot is filled, and this mod recognizes the id.
- `OptionalDouble zoom(ItemStack stack)` — stack's optic's own zoom factor, if it magnifies (`ScopeZoom#of`).
- `boolean hasZoomingOptic(ItemStack stack)` — Whether the widened `Player.isScoping()` gate (`COMBAT-REQ-006`) is satisfied by stack alone — a weapon with a magnifying optic attached; the caller still has to confirm the player is actually using it.
